allowed_extra_fields.name: Info-ZIP extended timestamp
allowed_extra_fields.local: flags bit0 set, bits3-7 zero, data size 1+4*popcount(flags bits0-2)
allowed_extra_fields.central: data size 5, flags 0x01 or equal to local flags, modification time equal to local

allowed_extra_fields.name: Info-ZIP UID/GID
allowed_extra_fields.data: size 11: version 1, UID size 4, UID, GID size 4, GID

profile.extra_field_rules: both extra areas must be fully framed as ID/size records before any ID is judged; each accepted ID at most once per header in any order; values are never applied
profile.needed_version_directory_exception: 10 is a compatibility exception to APPNOTE 4.4.3.2 (2.0 for a folder), accepted only for a verified empty directory
profile.descriptor: signature 08074b50 and three uint32 fields; all local CRC/size placeholders zero
profile.verified_empty_directory: safe identical local/central name ending /, consistent directory attributes, Store, no descriptor, CRC and both sizes zero, physical payload empty, all layout checks complete

required_checks.contract: independently compare local/central raw name, flags, method, needed version, CRC, sizes and extras; descriptor placeholders and actual values must match
overflow-safe bounded offsets; no reused local header, overlap, central-directory intrusion or out-of-input range
local entry intervals, central directory and EOCD explain every physical byte; never search compressed payload for record signatures
streamed actual size and CRC32 always compared, including recorded zero CRC
bounded ByteReader consumed length equals declared compressed range; exactly one fully terminated Deflate stream
independently validate creator, names, attributes, method, descriptor, physical payload; only verified empty directories excluded from AV; zero-byte regular files included
aggregate each container's normalized component tree; duplicate explicit entries and file/ancestor conflicts BLOCK independently of entry order
unsafe parent/absolute/drive/UNC/backslash/NUL/control/empty/dot components and alternate-path aliases BLOCK; opaque IDs used for extraction
unsupported valid ZIP is HOLD, never a permissive decoder fallback
actual input/decoded bytes, per-file/cumulative bytes, entries, container/directory depth, path bytes and exact integer ratio; limits inclusive, excess HOLD
container, normal file and verified empty directory distinct; every entry counted; AV original plus every extracted regular instance, with documented directory exclusions
independent entry/offset/size manifest must match archive/zip before using its decoder
